title: The SQL workbench read-only guard rejects statements whose leading keyword is read-only but whose body writes (EXPLAIN ANALYZE, data-modifying CTEs) and backend host-file primitives (FILE_WRITE / CSVREAD)

criteria.given: a logged-in ROLE_SQL_EXEC/ROLE_ADMIN caller posting EXPLAIN ANALYZE DELETE FROM customer
criteria.then: the workbench refuses it with 400 READ_ONLY_VIOLATION before a connection is opened

criteria.given: the same caller posting a data-modifying CTE (WITH d AS (DELETE FROM customer RETURNING 1) SELECT * FROM d)
criteria.then: the workbench refuses it with 400 READ_ONLY_VIOLATION

criteria.given: the same caller posting SELECT FILE_WRITE(STRINGTOUTF8('pwned'), '/tmp/saiku-pwned')
criteria.then: the workbench refuses it with 400 READ_ONLY_VIOLATION — no host file is written

criteria.given: the same caller posting an ordinary read-only SELECT 1
criteria.then: the workbench still answers 200 with the row — the guard did not narrow what a legitimate analyst runs

steps.name: EXPLAIN ANALYZE DELETE is rejected with READ_ONLY_VIOLATION
